settings.applied_variant.label: Applied variant
settings.applied_variant.description: Variant id of the recipe the native SkinService last applied; empty when no profile is active.
settings.family.label: Skin family
settings.family.description: Recipe family applied by the native SkinService. Stagecraft and Kumihimo are implemented; other families stay unavailable until their code wave.
settings.density.label: Density
settings.density.description: Compact tightens spacing and control sizes; comfortable is the default Stagecraft rhythm.
settings.topology.label: Topology
settings.topology.description: Where the persistent music scene and the System panel live. Published with the recipe; the native host also moves the music panel to match. Kumihimo's hanging-tags topology instead owns the transparent top bar and the Stagecraft scenes stay closed.
settings.surface.label: Surface
settings.surface.description: Primary charcoal surface color of the Stagecraft material.
settings.surface_variant.label: Surface variant
settings.surface_variant.description: Secondary surface color for tracks, meters and inner plates.
settings.text.label: Text
settings.text.description: Primary text color on Stagecraft surfaces.
settings.muted.label: Muted text
settings.muted.description: Secondary text color for labels, meta and Unknown states.
settings.accent.label: Accent
settings.accent.description: Subtle violet accent: focus edge, playing state, selected control.
settings.outline.label: Outline
settings.outline.description: Silver hairline color for card borders and separators.
